fair_value_reason: 50/50 of (a) ~14.25x Sep-2027 NTM core EPS of ~$17.5 (1/3 FY28 ~$16.2 + 2/3 FY29 ~$18.1, ~787M post-ASR shares, no investment gains) = ~$249, and (b) SBC-adjusted NTM FCF of ~$12.3B / ~787M = ~$15.7 at 6.4% = ~$245. I lowered the multiple from 14.5x in round 1 because organic growth shows no reacceleration yet and leadership churn is broader than one departure. The agent mean is $248.4; this is +7% vs spot, roughly a cost-of-equity return.

thesis_triggers.event: About 10x a ~$16.2 FY28 core EPS, near the June-2026 trough ($146-178). Below it the market is pricing an actual seat-base decline or a failed organic reacceleration (organic cRPO under ~8%, an FY28 guide under ~8%), not 45%-vol noise. The $182-average ASR would also be deeply underwater on ~$39B of debt.

supervisor_summary: All five forecasters took the round-1 corrections, and the fair values converged to $241-256 (mean $248). The gap to the $231 spot is mostly not edge. It is one year of EPS accretion at an unchanged ~14-14.5x multiple, about half of it from the debt-funded ASR, which is roughly the cost of equity for a levered 45%-vol name and matches the mature-software base rate of about +8%. Organic growth has sat at 7-8% for five quarters, and 2026 leadership churn is broader than the one departure the agents cite, so I trim the upper tail slightly and keep the mean otherwise. The early-December Q3 print is the real catalyst, and conviction is low until it shows organic reacceleration.
key_drivers: Organic growth has been stuck at 7-8% for five quarters (organic cRPO ~9% CC). The H2 reacceleration promised on NNAOV strength is untested until the early-December Q3 print, and it is the only path to a re-rating.

The gap to fair value is carry, not mispricing: ~14.7x current NTM core EPS (~$15.7) vs ~14-14.5x on Sep-2027 NTM (~$17.5). About half the EPS growth is the debt-funded ASR (~787M shares after October settlement).
Leverage: ~$39B of debt, ~$29B net debt after ~$5.1B for Contentful and Fin, and Moody's A2 stable. Interest is already in the run-rate.
Leadership churn through 2026 (Agentforce head, Slack and Tableau CEOs, CMO, CSO, then the engineering president; new COO in Aug) during the Agentforce execution test.
AI seat erosion is unmeasured: seats are undisclosed, attrition is steady at ~8%, and the Agentforce ARR definition was widened.
